question: The total of Discount Column appearing on the debit side of Triple Column Cash Book is posted to the
explanation: The debit side of the cash book records receipts from customers. Discount given to them is Discount Allowed, which is an expense or loss. So the column total is debited to Discount Allowed Account at the period end.

why_not.A: Discount Allowed is a loss, so it is debited, not credited.
why_not.C: Discount Received belongs to the credit side of the cash book.
why_not.D: Discount Received is credited, but it comes from the credit side column.

exam_tip: Debit side discount = Allowed, debited. Credit side discount = Received, credited. Remember: same side as the cash book.
